app.name: AnimeVerse Intelligence
app.tagline: Anime metadata, relationship and production intelligence
app.attribution: Initial metadata: cedya77/anime-offline-database (manami-project continuation) under ODbL 1.0 / DbCL 1.0.

states.emptyCatalog: No anime found. Import a snapshot via CLI or adjust filters.

catalog.title: Anime Catalog
catalog.subtitle: Search real imported works by title, synonym, season, studio or tag.
catalog.imageNotice: External URLs do not grant redistribution rights; neutral fallback is always enforced.
catalog.externalDisabled: AniList integration is disabled by configuration (local catalog remains 100% operational).
catalog.externalUnlinked: This anime does not have a verified AniList ID linked in the local catalog.
catalog.externalRateLimited: AniList rate limit temporarily reached. Please try again shortly.

relations.title: Anime Relationship Graph
relations.subtitle: Explore relatedAnime connections without inventing sequel or prequel semantics.
relations.unspecifiedNotice: All edges from this source are stored as UNSPECIFIED until verified external evidence exists.
relations.empty: Select an anime in the catalog to inspect its relationship network.

studios.title: StudioGraph — Companies and Works
studios.subtitle: Map of studios and producers linked to imported anime.
studios.peopleNotice: Studio and producer data only; individual staff credits (directors, animators) are not available in this source.

sources.title: Data Source & Ingestion Observatory
sources.subtitle: Read-only panel showing licenses, permissions and auditable CLI ingestion history.
sources.cliNotice: For security, ingestion runs exclusively through the local CLI (no public HTTP write endpoint).

future.loreDescription: Structural foundation prepared for arcs, characters, events and spoiler boundaries backed by licensed sources and human curation.
future.adaptationDescription: Structural foundation prepared for reviewed manga-chapter to anime-episode mappings without automated speculation.

about.title: About AnimeVerse Intelligence
about.subtitle: Specification-Driven Development (SDD), transparent provenance and strict license governance.
about.stack: Angular 22 (zoneless + Signals), Fastify 5, TypeScript 6, PostgreSQL + Drizzle ORM.
about.governance: Missing fields are never fabricated; unclassified links stay UNSPECIFIED; external images are never redistributed.
